snippet.title: Shared RC - co-op driving game (EXTREMELY FUNNY)
snippet.description:
#sharedrc #indiegame  #indiegames  #coopgames  #steamgame  #gamedev  #indiedev  #multiplayer #peak #repo #gettingoverit #chainedtogethergame #onlyupgame #onlyup 

This video is the announcement of Shared RC, set to release on Steam in October!

Two players.
One RC car.
Get to the top.

Work together, fight the physics, try not to F up and get blamed by your teammates.

SHARED RC is a multiplayer funny/chaotic physics-based co-op co-driving game.

The game is intended for audiences who enjoy:
- Peak
- Repo
- Only Up
- Chained Together
- Getting over it
- Lethal Company
- And especially Boat Together

Wishlist now and follow the journey 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475680/Shared_RC/
https://chillax.studio/
